title: How to get a startup idea from the Craigslist front page
summary: A one-line essay from Pieter Levels on idea generation: open the Craigslist front page and pick an item category that you could build a company around. It frames existing marketplaces as a ready-made source of validated demand.

principles.text: Mine existing marketplaces like Craigslist for startup ideas by picking an item category you could build a company around.
principles.quote: Go to the Craigslist front page and find an item you can build a company around
